extDescription.message: Fills in credentials from your local Kryptos vault. No server, no network.

footerText.message: Offline · your data never leaves the computer

unsupportedPageText.message: Open a login page to fill in your credentials.

vaultLockedText.message: Unlock it in the app to see passwords for this site.

appClosedText.message: Open the app on your computer and unlock the vault.

untrustedText.message: Kryptos refused the request because it couldn't verify the browser or extension. Use a supported browser and reconnect the app.

noLoginsText.message: Add a password for $SITE$ in Kryptos.

rateLimitedText.message: Too many requests in a short time. Try again in a minute.

confirmInAppText.message: Kryptos asks you to confirm this fill.

fillBusyText.message: Another fill is already waiting for confirmation in Kryptos.

saveNothingText.message: Type your password in the login form first, then save.

unchangedText.message: This login is already in Kryptos.
